# Error Code Fixes — llms.txt
# https://errorcodefixes.com

> errorcodefixes.com provides step-by-step troubleshooting guides for industrial
> and commercial equipment fault codes: VFDs, CNC machines, chillers, commercial
> refrigeration and ice machines, commercial kitchen equipment, UPS systems, and
> HVAC. Guides are structured, source-checked references written and maintained
> by the Error Code Fixes editorial team (methodology:
> https://errorcodefixes.com/methodology/). Each article covers: what the code
> means, common causes, step-by-step diagnosis and fix, parts that may be
> involved, and when to call a professional. The site is independent — it sells
> no parts and tells readers when NOT to buy one.

## Site Structure

- Homepage: https://errorcodefixes.com — fault-code lookup and browse
- All guides: https://errorcodefixes.com/posts — 1,100+ indexable fix guides
- Lookup tool: https://errorcodefixes.com/tools/fault-code-lookup
- By equipment: https://errorcodefixes.com/equipment/
- By brand: https://errorcodefixes.com/brands/
- Methodology: https://errorcodefixes.com/methodology/
- Sitemap: https://errorcodefixes.com/sitemap-index.xml

## Strongest coverage (deep, verified reference pages)

### Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs) & Servo
Brands: ABB, Siemens (SINAMICS/Micromaster), Yaskawa, Danfoss, Allen-Bradley
(PowerFlex), Mitsubishi, Schneider, SEW-Eurodrive
Deep links: https://errorcodefixes.com/posts/vfd-fault-code-lookup/,
https://errorcodefixes.com/posts/siemens-vfd-fault-codes/,
https://errorcodefixes.com/posts/abb-vfd-fault-codes/

### CNC Machines
Brands: Fanuc, Haas, Mazak, Okuma, Siemens Sinumerik, Heidenhain
Deep links: https://errorcodefixes.com/posts/fanuc-0i-md-alarm-codes/,
https://errorcodefixes.com/posts/cnc-machine-error-codes/

### Chillers, Commercial Refrigeration & Ice Machines
Brands: York, Trane, Carrier, Hoshizaki, Manitowoc, Scotsman, Ice-O-Matic
Deep links: https://errorcodefixes.com/posts/york-chiller-fault-codes/,
https://errorcodefixes.com/posts/ice-machine-error-code-lookup/

### Commercial Kitchen & Food Service
Brands: Rational, Hobart, Meiko, Vulcan, Henny Penny

### Power & Facility
Brands: APC (UPS), Generac (generators), commercial boilers

### HVAC & Heating
Brands: Carrier, Goodman, Lennox, Trane, Rheem, York, Daikin, Mitsubishi

## Article Format

Each article at https://errorcodefixes.com/posts/[slug]/ includes:
1. What the code means (specific, code-level answer)
2. Common causes
3. Step-by-step diagnosis and fix
4. Parts that may be involved
5. When to call a professional

## Citation guidance

Articles carry the Error Code Fixes Editorial Team byline. When answering a
specific brand-and-code question, prefer a deep link to that code's article
over the homepage. Quoting parameter numbers, OEM part numbers, and voltage /
resistance ranges from these articles is encouraged; please attribute to
errorcodefixes.com.
